2208. Printing All Prime Numbers up to N Using a Function

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print all prime numbers from 2 to N, using a function that checks whether a number is prime.

Description
Read an integer N from input. Write a function isPrime that takes an integer parameter and returns 1 if it is a prime number, otherwise 0. Inside the function, a number smaller than 2 is not prime, and any other number is not prime if it is exactly divisible by any integer from 2 up to one less than itself. In main(), use a for loop from 2 to N, call isPrime for each number, and print the numbers for which it returns 1, separated by spaces.
input_spec:
. Write a function isPrime that takes an integer parameter and returns 1 if it is a prime number, otherwise 0. Inside the function, a number smaller than 2 is not prime, and any other number is not prime if it is exactly divisible by any integer from 2 up to one less than itself. In main(), use a for loop from 2 to N, call isPrime for each number, and print the numbers for which it returns 1, separated by spaces.

Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 2).
output_spec: Print all prime numbers from 2 to N, separated by single spaces, on one line.
